fidelity: F2a — Peltier Cooler with Lumped Cold/Hot-Plate Thermal ODE
source: Rowe (2006) Thermoelectrics Handbook (CRC); Goldsmid (1986) Electronic Refrigeration (Pion); Ioffe (1957) Semiconductor Thermoelements and Thermoelectric Cooling

unit.name: Bi2Te3 TEC Module (40x40mm, 127 couples) — Physics-Lumped Peltier + Thermal ODE

alpha0.note: Per-element Seebeck coefficient at T0 (Bi2Te3 ~200 uV/K) — Goldsmid (1986)

k0.note: Per-element thermal conductivity at T0 — Rowe (2006)

sigma_e0.note: Per-element electrical conductivity at T0 (rho ~1e-5 ohm.m)

contact_resistance_fraction.note: Electrical contact resistance as fraction of element resistance

C_cold_J_per_K.note: Lumped heat capacity of cold plate + payload

C_hot_J_per_K.note: Lumped heat capacity of hot plate

hA_cold_W_per_K.note: Cold-side parasitic load conductance to ambient

hA_hot_W_per_K.note: Hot-side heat-sink conductance to ambient (forced convection)

Q_load_W.note: Active thermal load applied to the cold plate
